issues.what: Retells the sea's return as something Aysulu slept through, though she watched it from the cliff in ch1
issues.quote: You slept through the best part.

issues.what: Dawn market retold as a first visit with new details (blue-and-white batils, she paid) and the dead-crew reveal repeated
Grandmother 'died in that bed', contradicting the brief and ch3 (she drowned in the old sea)
issues.quote: Your grandmother died in that bed while the sea was leaving.

issues.what: Timeline drift: ch2 is Friday but calls the Friday-dawn boat trip 'yesterday'; market treated as new
issues.quote: Yesterday I took you where they used to sing.

issues.what: History: Aysulu (29, left at 12) was born after the sea left Moynaq, so cannot remember it; also salt tang attributed to freshwater Chimgan reservoirs
issues.quote: A little. The smell. The gulls.

issues.what: Salinity line wrong: 12 g/L is close to both old Aral (~10) and Caspian
Swim confession and the cannery-singing boat trip repeated as if new; grandmother now 'sang lower' vs 'loudest voice'
issues.quote: I cannot swim... I never told you.

issues.what: 'Your father was born in that room' vs 'I raised your mother' and mother's apricot tree
issues.quote: Your father was born in that room.

issues.what: Skiff becomes a 'batil'; tin cup reappears after sinking in the duffel; memorial 'needle' vs stone sailor; 'No gulls' then gulls on rails
issues.quote: The tin cup burned her palms

issues.what: Near-duplicate chapter titles 'Mending His Boat' / 'Mending the Boat'

fix: Ch1: she was born after the sea left; fix salt/salinity lines. Ch2: sets as Friday late morning, 'yesterday'->'this morning', grandmother drowned, mother not father. Ch3: stop retelling the return/market/swim confession as new, skiff not batil, tin cup, memorial, gulls; retitle ch2 and ch3.
praise: Luminous, patient prose and a genuinely moving ending: the old man letting the duffel sink to come back for his granddaughter.

issues.what: Chapters 2, 3 and 4 are all titled 'The Empty Bucket'
Mid-chapter recap retells the whole tale as if new and contradicts chs 1-2 (reed tune, three dance nights, Bouki frees the paws, 'bonjour' at night)
issues.quote: let us tell it true all in one string

issues.what: Recap song is mean-spirited ('Shovels are for fools'), not the ch1 song
Well is already finished, so the morning's digging has no stated purpose
'baby doll' for the gum figure sits too close to the banned phrase; 'tar baby' itself never appears

fix: Retitle ch2-4; frame the ch4 recap as Tante telling the tale to the egg and align its details with ch1-2; give ch3 digging a reason (deepen the well); swap 'baby doll'.
praise: Warm porch-tale voice with good sound words; Lapin asking Bouki for help and then picking up the rusty 'screek' shovel is a sweet, respectful turn on the tradition.

issues.what: Opening repeats ch1's broom-and-blank wake-up nearly word for word without acknowledging it
issues.quote: Her broom was sweeping all by itself. Very badly.

issues.what: Blue button is on the sill, then Posy 'pulls it out' at the hut
issues.quote: Posy pulled out the blue button.

issues.what: Whiskers appears 'by the pole' in the meadow without being placed there
issues.quote: the crinkly whiskery shadow by the pole

issues.what: Generic chapter title; the jam jar is not what the chapter is about

praise: Bright, bouncy read-aloud with a clear lesson (ask, don't order) and a lovely double homecoming at the portrait.
